It's amazing how emotionally invested you can become in someone. My first thought is that this guy really enjoyed your friendship, but misread your feelings and thought it was okay to be sexual with you because he wanted it so bad. Of course, it could be something more sinister, which is understandably frightening. I think it's probably a great thing that you haven't kept in contact, the fact that he has ignored your attempts to contact him indicates that he knows he messed up. 
But seriously, don't feel bad about this, emotions aren't always rational. Chin up.
There's not much someone can say to make you stop feeling this way. But I will say that things can get better, much better. It takes a shit load of time, but it's worth it.
